issue_context.title: Turbo does not forward `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` by default
issue_context.body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Turborepo canary release.

### Link to code that reproduces this issue

hard to do

### What package manager are you using / does the bug impact?

Yarn v2/v3/v4 (node_modules linker only)

### What operating system are you using?

Linux

### Which canary version will you have in your reproduction?

main

### Describe the Bug

Turbo v2 does not forward `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` by default, which breaks Node on my machine (Node is "installed" with [pkgx dev command](https://docs.pkgx.sh/using-dev/dev))

``` console
$ yarn turbo run build
• Packages in scope: ...
• Running build in 2 packages
• Remote caching disabled
┌ ...#build > cache miss, executing 66d3f08e30e78ed2 
│ /home/me/.pkgx/nodejs.org/v20.11.0/bin/node: error while loading shared libraries: libcrypto.so.1.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
│ command finished with error: command (/home/me/...) /tmp/xfs-4da40043/yarn run build exited (127)
└────>
 ERROR  run failed: command  exited (127)
error: Recipe `build` failed on line 8 with exit code 127
```

Adding `"globalPassThroughEnv": ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"]` to the turbo.json file fixes the bug

### Expected Behavior

`LD_LIBRARY_PATH` should be added to the list of forwarded env vars

### To Reproduce

This requires as rather heavy env set up, which I'm not sure how to provide. I might give a shot at creating a docker container if a maintainer deems it necessary.

### Additional context

_No response_
